items.title: How we took malware advisories beyond npm
items.content:
GitHub malware advisories no longer stop at npm. Here's how we wired OpenSSF's malicious-packages data into the Advisory Database, and why we built the pipeline paranoid.

The post How we took malware advisories beyond npm appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
GitHub malware advisories no longer stop at npm. Here's how we wired OpenSSF's malicious-packages data into the Advisory Database, and why we built the pipeline paranoid.
The post How we took malware advisories beyond npm appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Ankit Kumar Honey

summaries.zh: GitHub将恶意软件预警范围扩展至npm之外。通过将OpenSSF的恶意包数据接入预警数据库，并构建了名为"paranoid"的管道，实现了更广泛的监测。此举旨在提升代码安全性，确保更多依赖库得到及时预警。
summaries.en: GitHub expanded malware advisories beyond npm by integrating OpenSSF's malicious-packages data into its Advisory Database. The process involved building a pipeline to enhance detection capabilities. This update aims to provide broader protection against malicious packages across various sources. The initiative reflects GitHub's commitment to improving security monitoring.

items.title: Turn one giant AI-generated pull request to a reviewable stack
items.content:
Instead of one huge, un-reviewable pull request, teach coding agents to decompose work into a clean, ordered stack with GitHub stacked pull requests.

The post Turn one giant AI-generated pull request to a reviewable stack appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Instead of one huge, un-reviewable pull request, teach coding agents to decompose work into a clean, ordered stack with GitHub stacked pull requests.
The post Turn one giant AI-generated pull request to a reviewable stack appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Julia Muiruri

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了如何将一个巨大的AI生成的pull request分解为可审查的有序堆栈。建议通过训练编码代理，使用GitHub的堆叠pull requests功能，将大请求拆分为多个小请求，以提高代码审查效率。
summaries.en: The article discusses transforming a single large, unreviewable AI-generated pull request into multiple, manageable, and reviewable pull requests using GitHub's stacked pull requests feature. It emphasizes teaching coding agents to decompose work into an organized stack, improving review processes. The solution aims to enhance collaboration and maintainability by breaking down extensive changes into smaller, sequential pull requests.

items.title: Don’t stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed
items.content:
How a branch-free loop and byte-space arithmetic let GitHub case-fold every byte of code search at >45 GiB/s on a single core.

The post Don’t stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
How a branch-free loop and byte-space arithmetic let GitHub case-fold every byte of code search at >45 GiB/s on a single core.
The post Don’t stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Alexander Neubeck

summaries.zh: GitHub通过无分支循环和字节级算术，在单核上实现超过45 GiB/s的源代码大小写折叠搜索速度。该技术有效提升内存效率，避免早期终止。详情见GitHub博客文章《Don’t stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed》。
summaries.en: GitHub implemented a case-folding process for source code searches using a branch-free loop and byte-space arithmetic, achieving over 45 GiB/s performance on a single core. The method avoids early termination by processing each byte efficiently, ensuring memory-speed operations. The approach enhances search capabilities without compromising speed.

items.title: Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast
items.content:
Dependabot keeps your dependencies current, but its defaults can flood your repository with pull requests. Here's how grouping updates, slowing the cadence, and keeping security fixes fast cut the noise on a Microsoft open source project.

The post Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Dependabot keeps your dependencies current, but its defaults can flood your repository with pull requests. Here's how grouping updates, slowing the cadence, and keeping security fixes fast cut the noise on a Microsoft open source project.
The post Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Bruno Borges

summaries.zh: Dependabot 会自动更新依赖项，但默认设置可能导致大量拉取请求。微软开源项目建议通过分组更新、减缓更新频率、保持安全修复快速来减少干扰。这些方法有助于优化依赖管理，降低工作负载。
summaries.en: Dependabot can overwhelm repositories with frequent pull requests. To manage this, group updates to reduce noise, slow the cadence of non-security updates, and maintain rapid processing for critical security fixes. These strategies were applied to a Microsoft open-source project. The approach balances dependency management efficiency with repository stability.

items.title: Disrupting supply chain attacks on npm and GitHub Actions
items.content:
Explore the changes we've shipped across npm and GitHub Actions over the past few months to disrupt supply chain attack techniques and limit their impact.

The post Disrupting supply chain attacks on npm and GitHub Actions appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Explore the changes we've shipped across npm and GitHub Actions over the past few months to disrupt supply chain attack techniques and limit their impact.
The post Disrupting supply chain attacks on npm and GitHub Actions appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Greg Ose

summaries.zh: npm和GitHub Actions近期推出多项更新，旨在打击供应链攻击并减轻其影响。这些改动主要针对攻击技术，通过增强防护机制，限制攻击效果。更新内容涉及供应链安全策略和执行层面，以提升平台整体安全性。
summaries.en: The article discusses updates to npm and GitHub Actions aimed at countering supply chain attacks. Over recent months, both platforms have implemented changes to disrupt attack techniques and minimize their impact. The goal is to enhance security by mitigating vulnerabilities commonly exploited in software supply chains. The updates are part of ongoing efforts to protect developers and users from malicious activities. The article highlights these efforts as part of GitHub's commitment to maintaining secure development environments.
